comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 FY2024, the Company recorded a $58 million impairment charge for certain in-process R&D in the Data Center segment, related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD incurred significant non-cash impairment charges as a direct result of their respective 2024 Restructuring Plans. Intel reported $83 million in impairment charges on operating leased assets, whereas AMD recorded a $58 million impairment charge for in-process R&D (IPR&D) assets in the Data Center segment. Both companies recognized these charges within their 'Restructuring charges' line items during fiscal year 2024.

sentences.text: We also incurred non-cash impairment charges of $83 million on certain operating leased assets as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).

During the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Company determined that the fair value of certain IPR&D recorded within the Data Center segment was not recoverable resulting from actions related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan, and recorded an impairment charge of $58 million within Restructuring charges in the Company's Consolidated Statement of Operations.
